source_policy: 42 attributed Wikibooks recipes, 37 normalized records based on other published Vietnamese recipes, and 11 AI-authored Phase 2 legacy recipes. The 37 records use ingredient and procedure facts, credit their sources, and document unverified rights to upstream text and images. Selection excludes explicit reuse restrictions. The 11 legacy records keep their CC-BY-4.0 license.

excluded_sources.reason: Vietnamese records contain placeholder ingredients and generic steps.
Overview only, not a complete recipe.
Method stops before wrapping/steaming; do not mark complete.
Ingredient list and method inconsistent; requires editorial repair.
Recipe text also appears in a third-party cookbook with unverified redistribution rights. The method prepares tamarind and omits when to add it.
Sample rights limited; full commercial corpus is paid, not imported.

license_scope: CC-BY-SA-4.0 for the collection and normalized Vietnamese external records, with per-record licensing. Rights to original external text and images are outside this scope.
